law.text:
The following unlawful acts and offenses against animals shall constitute and be punished as a Class 3 misdemeanor:
Violation of § 3.2-6511 pertaining to the failure of a shopkeeper or pet dealer to provide adequate care to animals.
Violation of § 3.2-6509 pertaining to the misrepresentation of an animal's condition by the shopkeeper or pet dealer.
Violation of § 3.2-6510 pertaining to the sale of baby fowl.
Violation of clause (iv) of subsection A of § 3.2-6570 pertaining to soring horses.
Violation of § 3.2-6519 pertaining to notice of consumer remedies required to be supplied by boarding establishments.
